title: Incredible App - saving my life/memory
body: This app makes me so much better as an employee and as a person, I can’t do reminders, when I get busy I get stressed and I procrastinate - I need a slap in the face, I need someone to hold me down til I carry out the task, this app goes a long way to getting me there! The free service works but paying for the subscription is worth it, I’m also going to discuss with my employer about adding it to their own App Store - it’s a productivity life saving application!
author: gh2d09
